description: This file defines the SubjectType interface in Java, which represents a specific type of Subject used in policies within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes predefined constants and a static factory method to create new instances.

classes.name: SubjectType
classes.description: An interface extending CharSequence, representing different subject types used in policies. It provides constants for 'unknown' and 'generated' types, and a static method to create new instances.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: A static factory method that creates a new SubjectType instance with the given Character Sequence by delegating to PoliciesModelFactory.
